mazidi.title: The 8051 Microcontroller and Embedded Systems: Using Assembly and C
mazidi.authors: Muhammad Ali Mazidi, Janice Gillispie Mazidi and Rolin D. McKinlay

ray.title: Advanced Microprocessors and Peripherals
ray.listed_in_course_files: Case Studies Microprocessors and Microcontrollers.pptx (reading list)

8086-architecture-and-programming.read: The chapters on the 8086 architecture, instruction set and assembly programming
8086-architecture-and-programming.why: Listed in the course slides' reading list; the standard Indian textbook on the 8086 family.

8086-system-bus-and-multiprocessing.read: The chapters on 8086 pin signals, minimum and maximum modes, and multiprocessor systems (8087)
8086-system-bus-and-multiprocessing.why: Covers bus cycles, timing and coprocessor configurations as in the slides.

interfacing-with-the-8086.read: The chapters on memory and I/O interfacing and the peripherals 8255, 8253/8254, 8251, 8259 and 8279
interfacing-with-the-8086.why: Each peripheral chip in the slides, with interfacing diagrams.

8051-microcontroller-architecture.read: Chapter 1: The 8051 Microcontrollers; Chapter 5: 8051 Addressing Modes
8051-microcontroller-architecture.why: The standard 8051 textbook: features, pins, registers and RAM organisation.

8051-timers-and-serial-communication.read: Chapter 9: 8051 Timer Programming in Assembly and C; Chapter 10: 8051 Serial Port Programming
8051-timers-and-serial-communication.why: TMOD, TCON, mode 1 delays with an 11.0592 MHz crystal, SCON and SBUF.
